aka: The Hilarious Story of A Noble Class Man
trans_title: The Hilarious Story of A Noble Class Man
introduction: SYNOPSISWang-geun is the illegitimate son of Guk-gwang, a noble class man who owns a large farm. He is born with powerful male strength. Yong-pal, the farm caretaker, has a daughter named Woong-nyo who is also born with a very potent feminine energy. When Guk-gwang dies of high blood pressure, the farm is put in the hands of Chang-sik, his legitimate son. Chang-sik, unable to handle the sudden wealth and power wastes it and tragically ends his life as a drug addict. Now the family fortune is handed over to Wang-geun. Yoon-Jeong tries to educate the ignorant Wang-geun and make him into a leader and farm owner.
